info.name: F5 BIG-IQ DNS - Sequence (lab)
info.description:
Q. Questions: run folder 'A > Q Questions' after sign-in, then open Q.99 > Visualize and send the table back.
The same sequence as 'F5 BIG-IP DNS - Sequence', for when SBI manages the BIG-IP DNS devices through BIG-IQ.
The portal changes BIG-IQ's copy of the DNS configuration (working-config) and then DEPLOYS it to the BIG-IPs as a task.
Objects are addressed by id (UUID) and linked by selfLink; the test scripts store them in variables.
BIG-IQ access tokens last 5 minutes: the collection exchanges the 10-hour refresh token automatically.
Requests marked [verify] use request bodies from the BIG-IQ API reference that are not yet tested on a lab BIG-IQ.
Set baseUrl to the BIG-IQ address and 'password' (Current value). Turn off SSL verification for a lab certificate.

exec: // BIG-IQ: access token 5 min, refresh token 10 h. Exchange the refresh token when the access token is old.
body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken: { token: refresh } }) } },
(err, res) => { if (!err && res.code === 200) { store(res); } else { console.error("BIG-IQ token exchange failed", err || res.code); } });
if (!password) { console.warn("Set the collection variable 'password' (Current value) first."); return; }
body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({ username: pm.collectionVariables.get("username"), password: password,
(err, res) => { if (!err && res.code === 200) { store(res); } else { console.error("BIG-IQ login failed", err || res.code); } });
